en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: Abu Muhammad b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. `Imran al-Ash`ari narrated to us from al-Hasan b. al-Husayn al Lu’lu’i from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Abu `Uthman from `Ali b. al Mughirah from Abu `Imarah al-Munshid from Abu `Abdillah (as).

He said: He said to me: O Abu `Imarah! Recite [an elegy] about al-Husayn b. `Ali (as). He said: So, I recited it and he wept. Then I recited [again] and he wept. He said: By Allah! I had not ceased to recite it and make him weep until I heard the lamentation from the house.

He said: So, he said to me: O Abu `Imarah! Whoever recites about al-Husayn b. `Ali (as) and makes fifty people weep, for him is Paradise. And whoever recites poetry about al-Husayn and makes thirty people weep, for him is Paradise. And whoever recites about al-Husayn and makes twenty people weep, for him is Paradise. And whoever recites about al-Husayn and makes ten people weep, for him is Paradise. And whoever recites about al-Husayn and makes a single person weep, for him is Paradise. And whoever recites about al-Husayn and weeps, for him is Paradise. And whoever recites about al-Husayn and feigns crying, for him is Paradise.
